_how_to_use: Copy to code/business_entity_resolution/models_manifest.json (it ships in the zip) and fill it. audit_compliance.py validates it; keys starting with '_' are ignored. Every model the pipeline loads needs an entry in 'models': the final LightGBM matcher and any pretrained encoder. 'params' must be the EXACT integer count (HF safetensors.total, or `python .claude/skills/er-compliance-licensing/audit_compliance.py --count-params <files>`); the cap is 8,000,000,000 inclusive. 'license' must be MIT or Apache-2.0. 'files' / 'local_path' are resolved relative to the code tree; when they exist the audit re-counts the params and fails on any mismatch.

models.role: final pairwise matcher (the submitted model): p(same business) for each (s1, cand) pair
models.license_evidence: LightGBM library is MIT (github.com/microsoft/LightGBM LICENSE, verified 2026-09-25); the trees are trained by the team on student_resource/dataset/train only
models.params_method: exact: split thresholds + leaf values summed over every tree of every fold booster used at inference; fill in with --count-params on the files below
models.source: trained locally by src/run_pipeline.py --stage train (GroupKFold by S1)

_optional_model_entries.role: optional feature: cosine of Latin S1 name vs native-script S2/S3 name (zero-shot AUC 0.967 on 600+600 pairs)
_optional_model_entries.usage_note: prefix inputs with 'query: '; ~81 names/s on the laptop CPU, so encode only native-script India names and their S1 counterparts

_optional_model_entries.role: optional blocking / feature embedding (model2vec static, 101 languages; zero-shot cross-script AUC 0.939)
_optional_model_entries.usage_note: ~1,958 'name | address' strings/s on the laptop CPU (10M strings ~1.4 h). model2vec 0.9.0 from_pretrained has no revision= and defaults to force_download=True: snapshot once with the pinned revision, then load from local_path

_optional_model_entries.role: optional English-vocabulary static embedding (fastest: ~2,786 full strings/s, 10M ~1.0 h)

artifacts.how: normalize.learn_native_dict over TRAIN S1 <-> S2/S3 links only (never test)
artifacts._note: allowed origins: hand-written | learned-from-provided-train | generated-by-code. Delete this entry if the dict is rebuilt into work/ at run time instead of shipped.
